blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the automotive & discrete manufacturing operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers — OEE, escapes and launch time. Sensor fabric, vision inspection and scheduling intelligence move all three simultaneously, while IATF traceability and IT/OT security raise the baseline every program must respect.

items: OT/IT convergence without segmentation; ransomware stops lines.
Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.

blocks.x: The pattern composes AI Security & Model Protection, AI Security & Model Protection, AI Security & Model Protection from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Line changeover sequencing, Vision inspection, Predictive maintenance) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — IATF 16949 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
IEC 62443 zones with monitoring (line-stopping risk contained)
